Text: Jaclyn is an excellent content strategist and collaborator. I worked closely with her as a design strategist and user researcher on a project to help local residents better prepare for and respond to public emergencies like natural disasters. Jaclyn was proactive, thoughtful, willing to jump in, fully plugged into research design, interviews, and analysis, and always looking for the connections between the research and content design. In doing so, she was well-prepared to lead content that was directly informed by the people we were designing for. It was a joy to work with her, and I'd love to work with her again.
